subject: Air freight quote request: GRU and TLV
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Could you quote the fastest air freight option for each of these two shipments? Both will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-23 at our site in Wiesbaden, Germany (postcode 65996). Please arrange the truck from our site to the airport as part of the quote.

1. GRU (Sao Paulo, BR) — automotive sensors, 4 pieces, gross weight 1281 kg, volume 3.76 cbm.
2. TLV (Tel Aviv, IL) — machine parts, 1 piece, gross weight 1812 kg, volume 5.75 cbm.

Could you send both quotes in the same reply, with a separate all-in price in EUR for each shipment rather than a combined total?

Thanks for your help!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting quotes for two new air freight shipments.
